name: atlas-scope
description: Atlas Scope — 3D network investigation cockpit over the Cisco assessment engine's evidence snapshot.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.config.json && vite build
scripts.build:hub: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.config.json && vite build --mode hub
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit --noImplicitAny && tsc -p tsconfig.config.json --noEmit
